grid.sourceIndexing: map.lines[y].chips[x]; MapArray.ToArray transposes to internal array[x,y].
grid.warning: This is logical field space, not final screen pixels. Cell edge/padding and collision envelopes differ from marker extents.

markers.enemy: chip==2 OR chip==15+enterId, enumerated y then x by GetEnterPositions
markers.player: chips8..13 map to slots0..5; missing slot falls back to grid[5,8]
markers.playerFacing: deployWays[slot] preserved; facing 5 is automatic in enemy path

coordinates.logicalAxes: x increases with column, y increases with row
coordinates.renderY: CharacterUnit.UpdateCtrlPos applies FlipY before controller local position. Mirrored-world path additionally flips X. Full parent transform remains to be calibrated.
coordinates.groundLineExplanation: Units have individual field foot positions. No single global side-view ground line established.
coordinates.backgroundAuthorCoordinates: GameManager.ConvertMapPosition truncates authored x,y divided by32. X=(trunc(x/32)-1)*37.5-SystemConfig.virtualScreenWidth/2+18.75; Y=(1-trunc(y/32))*(GameResourceController field at0x220 /20)+SystemConfig.virtualScreenHeight/2. Some loader paths then FlipY. Do not feed these values to Map.ToPosition.

camera.formulaStatus: Transcribed from BattleScreenManager.Initialize; describes internal fields, not a certified visible viewport. Runtime SystemConfig resolution may change.
camera.needed: Capture actual Unity camera/parent transforms, viewport and UI occlusion on phone/tablet at normal and boss zoom. Safe-area screen bounds are not established by aspect ratio alone.

scales.warning: ImageScale static initializer values are not proof of final composed transforms.

sorting.unitDepthFormula: UpdateCtrlPos normal path: z = renderedY * GameManager.invHeight * 100; flag at 0x20c adds -1. Complete parent/camera/shader interpretation unresolved.

ranges.widthSemantics: Raw width/param/shape/offset values preserved; no radius/diameter interpretation asserted here.
